rawSiteProfile.notes: 149 catalogUrls = ALL product-bearing leaf categories. BC Stencil parent categories are non-inclusive on this theme — parents show subcategory tiles, not child products. Full coverage requires ALL leaves. /new-arrivals/ is the primary T1 watermark target (default=newest). Algolia is search-only, does not interfere with catalog. www.truenortharms.com 301s to truenortharms.com (apex). Product sitemap has 4420 entries but only 1264 are live/reachable via category browsing (rest are OOS/hidden). VIP Club has 144 exclusive products not in any other category.

watermark.notes: /new-arrivals/ defaults to newest-first (product IDs descending). ?sort=newest honored on all categories. T1 watermark walks from newest until hitting known product.

categoryStats.parentChildBehavior: BC Stencil parents do NOT include child products. Leaf categories required for full coverage.

algoliaOverlay.notes: Algolia loads only on search results page (conditional script). Does NOT hijack category catalog rendering. Native BC Stencil sort/pagination works on all category pages.
